    <id>http://arxiv.org/abs/1702.07382v1</id>
    <title>The Relation Between Fundamental Constants and Particle Physics Parameters</title>
    <updated>2017-02-23T20:30:30Z</updated>
    <link href="https://arxiv.org/abs/1702.07382v1" rel="alternate" type="text/html"/>
    <link href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/1702.07382v1" rel="related" type="application/pdf" title="pdf"/>
    <summary>The observed constraints on the variability of the proton to electron mass ratio $μ$ and the fine structure constant $α$ are used to establish constraints on the variability of the Quantum Chromodynamic Scale and a combination of the Higgs Vacuum Expectation Value and the Yukawa couplings. Further model dependent assumptions provide constraints on the Higgs VEV and the Yukawa couplings separately. A primary conclusion is that limits on the variability of dimensionless fundamental constants such as $μ$ and $α$ provide important constraints on the parameter space of new physics and cosmologies.</summary>
